descripcion.en:
Toni owes $260. Day 3: selling vegan peanuts, the idea a viewer left in the comments.
What business should he try tomorrow? Comment and he'll do it.

Comedy fiction series. Not financial advice.
#shorts #comedy #animation #money

texto.es: Día 3. Toni vende cacahuetes veganos en la calle, y un señor le acaba de explicar que todos los cacahuetes son veganos.
texto.en: Day 3. Toni is selling vegan peanuts on the street, and a man just explained to him that all peanuts are vegan.

texto.es: La idea no es suya. Se la dejó un seguidor en los comentarios. Toni debe 260 euros, así que no hace preguntas.
texto.en: The idea is not his. A viewer left it in the comments. Toni owes 260 dollars, so he asks no questions.

texto.es: Compra una bolsa por dos euros y le pega una etiqueta. Cien por cien veganos. Precio nuevo, seis euros.
texto.en: He buys a bag for two dollars and sticks a label on it. One hundred percent vegan. New price, six dollars.

texto.es: La gente le pregunta qué llevan entonces los cacahuetes normales. Toni no lo sabe. Dice que mejor no saberlo.
texto.en: People ask him what is in regular peanuts, then. Toni does not know. He says it is better not to know.

texto.es: Y funciona. Vende una bolsa. Seis euros. A una señora que cree que son sin gluten.
texto.en: And it works. He sells a bag. Six dollars. To a lady who thinks they are gluten free.

texto.es: En casa, su madre le recuerda que la bolsa la compró ella. Y que ahora vale seis euros.
texto.en: At home, his mom reminds him that she bought that bag. And that it is now worth six dollars.

texto.es: Balance del día 3. Gana seis, paga seis. Sigue debiendo 260 euros.
texto.en: Day 3 balance. He makes six, he pays six. He still owes 260 dollars.

texto.es: ¿Qué negocio prueba mañana? Coméntalo, y Toni lo hace.
texto.en: What business should he try tomorrow? Comment it, and Toni will do it.
